title: A New Classmate
description: A shy boy from England makes new friends.
instructions: Read about Ben. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🎒 On Monday, a new boy came to Class 4. His name was Ben and he was from England.
Ben looked shy. The teacher, Mr Long, said, 'Please say hello to Ben.' All the children said hello and smiled.
Ben sat next to Minh. At break time, Minh asked, 'Do you like football?' 'Yes, I do!' said Ben. 'I play every day.'
They played football in the playground. Ben ran very fast and he scored two goals. His new friends cheered.
At lunch, Ben tried some Vietnamese food. He ate spring rolls and he thought they were tasty. 'I want to learn Vietnamese,' he said.
After school, Minh taught Ben some words. Ben said 'xin chào' and everybody laughed. Ben was not shy now. He was happy.
